about: The question patterns for the six console tools the 9m and 50m were not yet taught (14 November 2026; Justin: 'Could we not get a thorp model to recognize all of our tools?', then 'actually see if you can do it on the 9m'). Written by Claude Opus 5.5 in the console-tools session, not by the corpus's usual teacher (Qwen3.8 27B), because the Mac's GPU was holding the 9m chat leg; read by backend/scripts/make_tool_corpus.py --version v3 beside lists/tool-teaching-v1.json. `near` are questions on the same topics that want no tool, so a ship learns not to fire an acting tool on a topic word.

near: What does a web browser do?
It is a program that opens pages on the web and shows them to you.
What is a search engine?
It is a site that finds pages on the web for the words you give it.
Who invented the telephone?
Alexander Graham Bell is usually given the credit, in 1876.
How does a phone call work?
Your voice is turned into a signal, sent along a line or through the air, and turned back into sound at the other end.
What is a drone?
It is a machine that does a job by itself, like a small aircraft with no pilot on board.
What does the word system mean?
It is a set of parts that work together as one whole.
Is it rude to hang up on someone?
It can be. It is kinder to say goodbye first.
What should I say when I answer the phone?
A simple hello and your name is enough.
Why is the internet slow sometimes?
Many people may be using it at once, or the line to your house may be weak.
What is a website?
It is a set of pages on the web that live at one address.
What is an audit?
It is a careful check that things are as they should be.
What is a policy?
It is a rule or plan that says how something should be done.
What is control in a business?
It is the work of making sure the plan is being followed and the money is well used.
Can a computer browse the web by itself?
Yes, a program can open pages and read them without a person at the keys.
What is a test line?
It is a phone line used for trying things out, where no real call is made.
How do I write a good email?
Say what you want in the first line, keep it short, and be polite.
What is a page on the web made of?
Mostly text, pictures and links, put together with a language called HTML.
What does online mean?
It means connected to the internet.
Why do people still make phone calls?
Because a voice carries feeling, and a talk can settle in a minute what messages take an hour to.
What is a transcript?
It is a written record of what was said.
What is the weather?
It is the state of the air at a place and time: how hot or cold, wet or dry, still or windy it is.
What is a task?
It is a piece of work to be done.
What does coordination mean?
It means getting different parts to work together without getting in each other's way.
What is intelligence in an army?
It is the gathering of news about the world outside so that good choices can be made.
Tell me a joke about phones.
Why did the phone wear glasses? It lost its contacts.
Do you like the internet?
It is useful, and it holds a great deal, but not all of it is true.
What is an operation?
It is a piece of work being carried out, often with several steps.
How do you say hello politely on a call?
Good morning, this is your name. How can I help?
What is a link on a web page?
It is a word or picture you can click to go to another page.
Why do websites ask about cookies?
Because some places need your yes before a site may store small notes about you in your browser.
Is the web the same as the internet?
No. The internet is the network; the web is the pages that travel on it.
What is a phone number made of?
Digits: often an area or country code, and then the number of the line itself.
What does it mean to hang up?
It means to end a phone call.
What is a system status page?
It is a page that says whether each part of a system is working.
Should I trust everything I read online?
No. Check who wrote it, and look for the same fact in a second place.
How many people use the internet?
Most people in the world do, a little over two thirds of them.
What is a browser tab?
It is one page open in a browser, beside the others, so you can move between them.
What did people use before phones?
Letters, messengers and, from the 1840s, the telegraph.
Is it safe to fill in forms online?
Mostly, on sites you know. Be careful with any site that asks for money or passwords.
What is a viable system?
It is one that can keep itself going in a changing world: it runs, coordinates, controls, looks outward and holds to its purpose.
